text:
Nina Park: Heads up 1 adding an "explain" panel to rollout preview so SREs can see why auto-fallbacks fire. Need to balance trust vs noise.

Samir Gupta: High level: show reason category (latency/error/quota), a one-line metric snapshot when relevant, and an audit link. No stacks or raw output.

Tara O'Neill: UX: collapsed by default, small chevron to expand. Show auto vs manual with a tiny badge. Hover reveals operator id/timestamp.

Nina Park: For errors show normalized class (eg grpc-unavailable) + last status code. For latency show p90/p99 and the model variant routed to.

Samir Gupta: API proposal: add policy_explain string fields to rollout API response: reason_code, brief, routed_to, audit_id, sample_masked (opt-in). sample_masked off by default.

ops-bot: rollout-preview created by @Nina Park for policy=contingency-lite /console/rollouts/preview/lf9a3 :robot_face:

Tara O'Neill: Also add a low-rate telemetry sampler (sample_rate_pct) at rollout config level so we can collect masked contexts for tuning thresholds. Store only hashes/fingerprints with retention rules.

Samir Gupta: We should gate expanded details by role. Operators without audit access get a summary card and a CTA to request deeper access.

Nina Park: Good. Can someone mock console card and example API payloads? Id like to land this before Fridays UI freeze.

Tara O'Neill: I'll attach mocks and masking rules to the PR. Will also include examples of sanitized payloads.

Samir Gupta: I'll add the sampling flag and audit linkage in the backend PR. Assigning reviewers: @Tara O'Neill, @Nina Park.

Nina Park: Thanks team. Quick follow-up: include a tiny note when fallback is due to quota (quota name + short remaining tokens). Actionable info only.

ops-bot: PR created: rollout-explain-card-api by @Samir Gupta -> review requested: @Tara O'Neill, @Nina Park
